title: 入学・進級のお祝い
lead: 入学式・ランドセル・桜・新しい教室など、入学と進級のお祝いの場面12点です。入学おめでとうのカードや案内状に使えます。
subject_en: Flat illustration of school entrance celebrations in Japan, each ONE small scene, centred, spring colours, friendly natural faces. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
